Use cases / Identity risk

Identity risk, in the context of what it can reach.

Review privileged access and identity findings as part of the wider security picture, next to the resources and exposure they relate to.

Get a demo See it in the explorer

THE CHALLENGE

Why this is hard today.

Privilege accumulates

Elevated access is easy to grant and rarely reviewed against what a workload needs.

Identity sits between issues

The same identity can connect an exposed asset to a sensitive resource.

Reviews lack evidence

Deciding whether access is justified needs the resource and assessment context beside it.

HOW SAFORA HELPS

Three steps, one workspace.

  1. 01

    Start from identity findings

    Identity & Access lists access findings to review alongside the other security domains.

  2. 02

    See what the access touches

    Follow the associated resources and exposure in the same investigation.

  3. 03

    Record the decision

    Finding status, comments and history keep the review traceable.
